dedupe_keys.name: experience curve data for energy storage technologies

description: This dataset pairs cumulative deployed capacity with product prices for electrical energy-storage technologies. Storage Lab provides it as the evidence used to construct experience curves and examine future investment costs in the book Monetizing Energy Storage. The canonical Figshare record publishes a versioned Excel workbook whose filename identifies a 1 December 2022 compilation. The provider explains its use for projecting cost ranges, estimating deployment needed to reach cost targets and comparing storage technologies. Geographic coverage and the complete historical time span are not specified in the inspected landing metadata, and the individual technology list, currency basis and units were not read from the workbook. Access is public and free under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is that experience-curve projections depend on historical cost definitions and deployment assumptions; the published data do not establish guaranteed future prices. Simulation uses include storage-cost scenarios and investment sensitivity analysis. It relates to data-marktstammdatenregister-mastr-germany as a separate deployment source, without implying direct comparability. This record identifies the spreadsheet release, not the book or the collection of external storage-map links on the provider page. The workbook was not downloaded.
